_s9d_customdata_basis: 1.21.9 dropped CustomData's entity / block entity members (parseEntityId, parseEntityType, loadInto x2), update / read x2, size, contains, getUnsafe and CODEC_WITH_ID when that data moved to TypedEntityData (javap -c both). The members come back on CustomData with 1.21.8's bodies (mixin/CbCustomDataRestoredMixin) over the same tag; every call they make is still in 1.21.9. CODEC_WITH_ID is public static, which a mixin cannot merge: get-static reads rt/CbCustomData.CODEC_WITH_ID (1.21.8's validate body).
